how: Halo 2: Anniversary armor in the configuration's appearance block, the same layout as Halo 4 (regions at +0x58: 0 helmet, 1 chest, 3 and 4 the shoulders, 5 forearms, 6 legs; Oct 24 live dump and Halo 4's equip log). Unlike Halo 4, groundhog.dll's Armory catalog lists one variant per armor slot (MCC keeps H2A's piece mixing elsewhere), so the region values are set directly: each is an armor set number, the local player's being 0-2 (MCC's list: 0 Mark VI, 1 Centurion, 2 Hoplite; Elites 0-2 too, Data/UI/playercustomization.xml). Original Experience: one set worn whole (the 2014 launch had no piece mixing). Modern: each piece from the three or MCC's 77 added Spartan pieces (Oct 28, docs/HANDOFF_armor_oct28.md): the region values are the indices of ca_lockout.map's customization table (read again from ca_lockout and ca_relic.map, the same as the H2AMPEK kit tag): helmet 0-2 the sets, 3 infected, 4-6 the Elite's, 7-23 MCC's (Orion, Bioroid, Robot, Trooper, Breach, Panzer); chest 7-20 MCC's; shoulders 3-20 MCC's (no Elite entries); forearms and legs 3-5 the Elite's, 6-10 MCC's. 17 + 14 + 18 + 18 + 5 + 5 = unlockdb's 77 H2A_Spartan pieces. The 'names' lists are the table's own names (MCC's menu calls the Trooper pieces Buzzkill, Sandsting, Seawing, Tusk: which is which is not proven). H2A has no armor effects. Visor: +0x4B (Halo 4's visor byte) stayed 0 through a change on the local player and 1 / 3 moved nothing on an Elite; a Spartan's visor was not probed (the original content list names no H2A visor). Decoded Oct 26 evening on an Awash BOT OBSERVER map (diff of the local player's configuration after setting yellow / green and an Elite, then probed bot by bot with tools/look_sheet_aim.py): +0x4C species (0 Spartan, 1 Elite: both seen whole, Elites with sets 0, 1, 2 and mixed), +0x49 primary and +0x4A secondary colour (0-29 as Halo 4's: 0 near black, 29 its own shade, 30 the same steel blue on both species, the game's fallback past the list). Bots are Spartans for now (the species set, so they no longer copy the local player's Elite): rolling Elites waits on sign-off and the profile view showing an H2A Elite (its species picker and Elite set names). +0x53-0x55 changed with the colours and moved nothing seen (the emblem's, as Halo 4's). Names (Oct 28 night): MCC own (EN_Global strings), the Trooper, Breach and Panzerdoll pieces matched to the table by renders against Halopedia icons: trooper_hornet = Buzzkill, elephant = Tusk, pelican = Seawing, scorpion = Sandsting; breach_a = Breach Scout, breach_b = Breach Link (helmets; the chests and shoulders keep A / B); robot = Megaframe.
elites: Oct 28 (every profile finished, H2A's Elite included): the species is rolled last, 1 in 5 Elite like Halo 3's, so the draws before it (the Spartan colours and sets) stay as they were: the first field keeps its old draw under the name spartan and the species field writes +0x4C over it. An Elite wears the customization table's Elite entries (ca_lockout.map, read by hand Oct 27 and again Oct 28: helmet and chest options 4-6 helmet_elite_var_1-3 / torso_elite_var_1-3, forearms and legs 3-5 arms_elite_var_1-3 / legs_elite_var_1-3; options 0-2 are the Spartan sets, which an Elite does not wear: the Oct 26 probe of Elites with 0, 1, 2 showed one default Elite), whole in Original (same_shift: the limbs one lower), mixed in Modern. armor_var1-3 = MCC's Elite sets 0-2, named Combat, Outrider, Invader in the original content list (original_content.json). NOT SEEN LIVE: the bytes 4-6 / 3-5 on a bot.
